Creatine is one of the most misunderstood supplements, yet one of the most important tools for improving strength. Creatine is used by your muscle cells to produce energy. During strenuous exercise, your body uses this energy source to help you power through your workouts. Supplementing with creatine will also help replenish muscle creatine.
